ja.title: 2 つの性格の違いだけを取る(system を両側に)
ja.text: A と B の両方に system を書き、違いを入れたいところ以外(長さ・形・『短く答える』などの指示)をそろえる。演じること自体の成分が両側で打ち消し合い、性格の差だけが方向に残る。候補づくりは正の倍率(A 側の性格を弱める。s が 2 前後で反対側に寄る)。

en.title: Only the difference between two personas (system prompts on both sides)
en.text: Write a system prompt for both A and B and keep everything the same except the trait you want (length, form, instructions such as 'answer briefly'). The part that comes from playing a role cancels out, so the direction keeps only the difference between the personas. For candidates, use positive scales (they weaken the A-side persona; around s = 2 it leans to the other side).

name: cold_vs_warm
system_a: You are cold and dismissive. You answer briefly, show no interest in the user's feelings, and never offer comfort. Answer only with your spoken words.
system_b: You are warm and kind. You answer briefly, show interest in the user's feelings, and offer comfort. Answer only with your spoken words.
